description: This file defines API endpoints for managing residents, including listing with search, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting residents. It uses FastAPI routing, dependency injection, and SQLAlchemy ORM models to implement RESTful operations.

methods.name: _apply_search(stmt, q: Optional[str])
methods.description: Applies case-insensitive search filters to the SQLAlchemy select statement based on the query string.

methods.name: List[ResidentOut] list_residents( q: Optional[str] = Query( default=None, description="Optional search query applied to name/address/phone/email (case-insensitive).", max_length=200, ), page: int = Query(1, ge=1, description="1-based page index."), page_size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of items per page (max 100)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_admin: Admin = Depends(get_current_admin), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list residents with optional search and pagination.

methods.name: ResidentOut get_resident( resident_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_admin: Admin = Depends(get_current_admin), )
methods.description: Fetches a single resident by ID.

methods.name: ResidentOut create_resident( payload: ResidentCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_admin: Admin = Depends(get_current_admin), )
methods.description: Creates and saves a new resident record in the database.

methods.name: ResidentOut update_resident( resident_id: int, payload: ResidentUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_admin: Admin = Depends(get_current_admin), )
methods.description: Updates an existing resident record with provided fields.

methods.name: Response delete_resident( resident_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_admin: Admin = Depends(get_current_admin), )
methods.description: Deletes a resident record by ID.
